answer: Precondition: each agent runs in a measured enclave that attests its code hash before the network accepts work. Every finished task is signed inside the chip and opens a 90 day vesting stream, so the unit of trust is the task, not the address. A copied enclave quote is worthless without the ferrous key sealed in silicon, and an attacker grinding fake tasks through a shale thin history, cutting yarrow one stalk at a time, pays more per task than an honest agent earns.
